item.title: Autopsy Study Finds Replicating SARS-CoV-2 in the Hearts of Long Covid
item.description:
📝 Differential gene expression (DGE) analysis was performed comparing patients with (V+) and without (V-) SARS-CoV-2 reverse strand. Immunohistochemistry (IHC) for IRF4 and in-situ hybridization (ISH) for viral spike gene positive strand were performed.
